description: Weak, graded unit; no clean concept. Fires mostly in the early middlegame (about 8-15 stones) when the stones sit in a tall centre-left block: column 3 at height 4-5 (or empty) with column 2 built up to 3+, while columns 1, 4, 5, 6 stay nearly empty. Column 3 at height 1-3 or full, or stones piling up on the right, switch it off.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every move probability by at most 0.03.
notes: Layer 1 unit that behaves like a sum of many small column-height and cell terms (a mixture). Best dev F1 0.390 (P 0.41, R 0.37, AUROC 0.68, sim share 0.15) from a hand-weighted height score; simpler rules (F1 0.21) and other variants (0.29-0.39) did no better. Exceptions it misses: late-game boards with a deep empty well between full columns, and boards with column 3 empty and columns 0-2 tall. Side to move and colours matter somewhat (column 2 reading O,X,O,X from the bottom beats X,O,X,O). Score call 2 was wasted by accidentally re-running call 1. Two synthesis positions beat the dev max (2.95, 2.68 vs 2.42).
